en.headline: Howard Hung takes men's kata bronze for Hong Kong at Asian Games
en.dek: The karate athlete defeated Malaysia's Mohamad Henry after a semi-final loss, giving Hong Kong its second karate medal of the Games after Grace Lau's silver.
body: Hong Kong's Howard Hung won bronze in the men's individual kata at the Asian Games in Nagoya on Monday, securing the territory's second karate medal of the competition.

Hung lost 1-4 to Macao's Fong Man-hou in the semi-finals but dominated the bronze-medal bout against Malaysia's Mohamad Henry, receiving higher scores from all five judges. The event awards two bronzes; Hung shared the podium with Kuwait's Sayed Almosawi.

The result follows Grace Lau's silver in the women's individual kata on Sunday. Hung said Lau's performance had motivated him and that she had offered tactical advice. He earlier beat opponents from Mongolia and South Korea.
Hong Kong's medal tally on Monday also included Lydia Sham's gold in women's wushu changquan and bronze in the mixed triathlon relay.

zh.headline: 洪浩威空手道男子個人型奪銅 港隊亞運第二面空手道獎牌
zh.dek: 洪浩威於準決賽落敗後，在銅牌賽擊敗馬來西亞對手，為香港帶來本屆亞運第二面空手道獎牌，繼劉慕裳銀牌後再添一銅。
body: 港隊空手道運動員洪浩威周一在名古屋亞運男子個人型賽事奪得銅牌，為香港帶來本屆賽事第二面空手道獎牌。
洪浩威準決賽以1比4不敵澳門選手馮文豪，但其後在銅牌賽以全場五位裁判較高分數擊敗馬來西亞的莫哈末亨利。該項目設兩面銅牌，洪浩威與科威特選手賽耶德·阿爾莫薩維一同登上頒獎台。
這面銅牌緊隨周日劉慕裳女子個人型銀牌。洪浩威表示，劉慕裳的表現激勵了他，並獲對方提供技術意見。他早前亦擊敗蒙古及南韓對手。
港隊周一另有沈曉榆武術女子長拳金牌及鐵人三項混合接力銅牌入帳。
